outcome: Total mTOR expression in fetal hippocampi
4EBP1 activity and expression in fetal hippocampi
p70S6K activity and expression in fetal hippocampi
cohort: Pregnant rats exposed to e-cig aerosols and their fetuses.
finding: Gestational e-cig vaping with nicotine significantly increased P-mTOR levels, RAPTOR, RICTOR, 4EBP1, and p70S6K activity/expression, while decreasing P-PKCa in rat fetal hippocampi, indicating dysregulation of mTORC1 and mTORC2 signaling pathways.
